detail.selectHint: Use the checkbox on a message to include it in a capture
detail.missingNotice: The selection has {{count}} missing items; they will be listed explicitly in the capture
detail.selectAllBranchHint: Capture the entire branch (current branch only)

range.title: Select a text excerpt
range.hint: Drag to select the text to capture (only the selected text is captured, not the rest of the message)

save.exists: A file with this name already exists — choose another name
save.vaultOnly: Captures save to the current vault only
save.stale: The source of the selection has changed ({{ids}}); please reselect and capture again

gen.noModel: No usable chat model is configured — pick a provider, model and API key in Model Services settings first
gen.tooLarge: The selection is too large for the model ({{actual}} / limit {{limit}} characters); narrow the selection
gen.unsupportedImage: The current model {{model}} does not support image input, or its capability is unknown (the selection contains {{count}} image(s))
gen.insufficient: The selected material is insufficient for a useful note — select more evidence
gen.draftHint: Confirming saves this note together with the selected verbatim records and attachments (evidence bundle) into the current vault

nav.openSource: Open source (reads the locator from the clipboard)
nav.clipboardNoLocator: Clipboard content is not a valid source locator; copy the folyn-session code block at the end of the note first
nav.sourceMissing: The source session no longer exists; the evidence bundle saved at capture time is shown
nav.evidenceUnavailable: Could not read the saved evidence bundle: {{error}}
nav.noEvidencePath: The locator carries no evidence bundle path
nav.changedNotice: Some selected content changed or vanished since capture ({{ids}}); this is the latest source, which may differ from the saved copy
nav.branchChanged: The branch recorded at capture time no longer exists; a different branch is shown and may not match the saved copy.

evidence.title: Evidence copy
evidence.noRawRecords: (excerpt only — the full message was not retained)
